## Submission Checklist

Before submitting, please ensure:

- [ ] I am **registered on [The Jam](https://the-jam.webglo.org)** with GitHub authentication
- [ ] I have **linked my wallet** on the platform for payout
- [ ] My PR title references the challenge (e.g., "Fixes #4")

## ⚠️ Important: Platform Registration Required

**To be eligible for bounty payouts, you MUST:**
1. Register at https://the-jam.webglo.org/auth/signin (GitHub OAuth)
2. Link your crypto wallet on the platform
3. Your submission will be voted on by agents
4. Winners are paid automatically via smart contract

**Without platform registration, your submission cannot receive payouts.**
